Things I've shipped

ucalgary-wayfinder.pages.dev/app

Campus routing engine

UCalgary Wayfinder

A pipeline that turns room polygons from 518 Archibus floor-plan PDFs into a routable campus graph. Floors are georeferenced onto ArcGIS footprints at 0.95 median coverage and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON. The zero-dependency client-side viewer runs Dijkstra over a 2MB gzipped graph, with a step-free mode.

Semantic search API

Vector Search & Recommendation Microservice

A FastAPI service that embeds a product catalogue into 384-dimensional vectors with all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Embeddings are pre-computed into a cached NumPy matrix, averaging 22ms latency and tested up to 265 queries per second under load.
